title: Chapter 161 The Zerg’S Fight Cannot Stop
content:
Chapter 161 The Zerg’S Fight Cannot Stop

Wu Qing invited Nagaron back to his original position and began to talk about the theme this time.

"Let me first explain what everyone is concerned about."

"We Zerg and the Independent Territory Alliance jointly counterattacked this city. During the battle, the evil god's army in the city held a sacrifice ceremony to the evil god, which attracted the evil god himself to come!"

"The large number of Evil God's troops in the city have been personally blessed by the Evil God!"

"The Zerg and Alliance armies were no match for the power of the evil god. The Zerg used the power given by the Zerg Lord to finally destroy the powerful enemy and regain the city!"

"The collision between the power of the Lord and the power of the Evil God resulted in a big explosion, the power is amazing!"

"The final battlefield is outside, everyone is free to observe it!"

Wu Qing introduced the cause of the big explosion.

Everyone is listening carefully. This is their main task here today.

"In other words, those two violent energy fluctuations were caused by the collision between the power of the Zerg master and the power of the evil god?"

Gong Zhe was the first to ask Wu Qing.

"Yes, the Evil God's Army's Evil God Sacrifice Ceremony luckily attracted the Evil God to come. Without the power of the Lord to destroy them, this area will be in danger!"

Wu Qing was telling the truth. If the nearly 50,000 evil god's army that had been blessed by the evil god were to fight out, the Tengu tribe in this area would definitely be doomed.

"The evil god is coming, I haven't heard such news for a long time!"

"Every time I hear news like this, it's a huge tragedy!"

"Fortunately, you have the Lord's protection behind you, so you can avoid danger!"

"This puts me at ease. Our Goblin Chamber of Commerce has no doubts!"

Gong Zhe mainly wanted to ensure the safety of this area. If the branch was just established and this area became the territory of the evil god camp, then he would become the laughing stock of the clan.

"Now that the Zerg are within our territory, such risky actions as actively attacking the Evil God's camp should be carried out after consultation with our clan, rather than acting on their own!"

"Otherwise, it will cause irresistible danger, which will jeopardize the deployment of the entire camp!"

Gou Yin stood in the position of the Tengu clan and was questioning.

Although Gou Yin admires the birth of the Zerg tribe, he represents the Tengu tribe and must focus on the interests of the Tengu tribe.

The development and growth of the Zerg tribe is encroaching on the interests of the Tengu tribe.

"That makes sense. I am now officially informing the nobles, the Zerg and the Independent Territory Alliance to start a full-scale counterattack against the Evil God camp and regain the lost territory from today!"

Wu Qing said sternly to Gou Yin.

His words left Gou Yin at a loss as to how to answer them.

"Okay! It is an honor for my Naga clan to be neighbors with the Zerg and the Independent Territory Alliance!"

"If necessary, our Naga clan will fully cooperate!"

Nagaron applauded Wu Qing’s statement!

If the Zerg and the Independent Territory Alliance launch a full-scale counterattack against the Bugbears in the Evil God camp, the pressure on the Nagas will be greatly reduced. At least the Bugbears' troops will not frequently invade the Nagas' territory.

For Nagaron, this is a turn of events and a bright future!

"If you counterattack, we will counterattack too! Let's see who can regain more territory then!"

Gou Bao shouted unconvinced.

Gou Yin opened his mouth, but finally made no sound.

"Very good, I'm just waiting for you Tengu clan to send troops to counterattack, so that we will be less stressed!"

Wu Qing said to Gou Bao with a smile.

"If you really send troops to counterattack the evil god's camp, I will take back what I said before!"

Nagaron took a deep look at Gou Yin and added.

When he came here, he only needed to understand the situation of the big explosion and report back. He did not need to express any opinions on this matter.

"Let's go see the scene and feel the collision of god-level power for ourselves!"

Gong Zhe came out to smooth things over and interrupted the topic.

Next, Wu Qing took everyone to the center of the explosion to have a look, and everyone asked some questions of concern. This time the matter was considered completed.

…

The task was completed, and none of the three parties left. Instead, they all used the excuse that it was getting late and asked to stay overnight.

Wu Qing could understand that Gong Zhe and Nagaron wanted to stay, but the Tengu clan also wanted to stay, which was somewhat beyond his expectation.

Wu Qing told the three parties that if they came to him for help, they could ask the nearby Zerg to lead the way, and then left.

It didn't take long for Gou Bao to come to him in a hurry.

"Lord Wu Qing, I came here to discuss important matters. I wonder if it's inconvenient for you right now?"

"Please tell me!"

"That's right, I like the ever-changing equipment you gave me very much. I want to purchase a batch from you and form an army fully equipped with this equipment!"

"I want to lead such an army to fight back against the evil god's camp! Recover the lost ground!"

Gou Bao said excitedly.

Wu Qing didn't expect that he came here for this matter. He was obviously very wary of biological reproductive equipment, and now he wanted more.

"The equipment I gave you is very precious, and I don't have many sets myself."

After listening to Wu Qing's words, Gou Bao was a little frustrated and said: "This is an idea I have been thinking about for a long time. I already have a lot of interesting ideas. I will definitely be able to train a strong army!"

"Tell me how many sets you have! I want them all!"

Gou Bao still doesn’t give up.

"I have a batch of equipment with similar functions but much lower quality. It's up to you if you want it."

"Yes! As long as the functions are similar, I want it!"

Next, Wu Qing talked seriously about business with Gou Baobao of the Tengu tribe. The old man of the Tengu tribe just stood by and watched quietly.

This chapter is not over yet, please click the next page to continue reading!

Wu sold a batch of popular biological colonization suits to Gou Bao at a high price. This batch of biological colonization suits will lock their evolutionary functions. The energy and luck they absorb will be directly fed back to the system and converted into energy and qi.

In this transaction, Wu Qing only accepted the luck beads. This Gou Baobao was really generous and agreed directly, and agreed on the time and place of the transaction.

The transaction was reached, both parties were very satisfied, and Gou Bao left happily.

…

The second person to come to Wu Qing was Nagalong.

Gong Zhe must have known that everyone stayed to talk to Wu Qing alone. He intended to let the other two families talk first. He was ready to have a good exchange with Wu Qing about his own affairs, and he was not in a hurry.

"Hello, Lord!"

As soon as they met, Nagalong saluted respectfully.

The two sides exchanged politeness again before getting to the point.

"The sudden retreat of the Tengu tribe completely exposed our flank to the front of the evil god camp. Our tribe was caught off guard and suffered heavy losses!"

"Our tribe has been fighting the evil god camp with a large number of territories as its depth!"

"My tribe learned that the Tengu tribe had won a key battle, so they sent me to ask the Tengu tribe to send troops to contain the bear goblins and relieve the pressure on our tribe!"

"But they refused directly!"

"Today, I heard that the lord was going to lead the army to counterattack, so I came to discuss with the lord about the two tribes watching each other and cooperating in combat!"

Nagalong briefly told Wu Qing the cause and effect of the matter and explained his purpose.

"Tell me about the current situation first!"

Wu Qing and Nagalong had an in-depth exchange and discussion on the situation of the camp war in the surrounding areas, which gave Wu Qing a better understanding of the situation in the surrounding areas.

In general, Nagalong is very familiar with the situation of the Naga territory, but has limited knowledge of the situation of the bugbears on the opposite side of the Tengu and Zerg. He only knows that many bugbear armies attack their territory from the flank.

If the Zerg wants to launch a full-scale counterattack against the bugbears, they have to rely on themselves.

Thinking of the increasing number of Zerg puppies in the Zerg, combined with the situation just learned, Wu Qing suddenly had an idea.

"The Zerg has just been born, and the situation of the enemy on the opposite side is not well understood. The counterattack can only be done step by step, and the speed is definitely not fast!"

"It may not solve the urgent needs of the nobles!"

"I have an idea, I don't know if it is feasible!"

"The Zerg will send troops to help you stabilize the front line. When the situation improves, how about we counterattack together?"

Wu Qing told Nagalong his idea.

The Zerg's standing forces must never be idle, and idleness is a waste!

While ensuring the safety of their own territory, the Zerg needs to constantly find wars to fight. Only by constantly fighting can the Zerg develop rapidly.

The Zerg now has so many standing troops, the mysterious enemy does not attack at night, and the large-scale gathering of evil god troops cannot be found around during the day.

The scattered evil god camp bases can no longer satisfy the appetite of the Zerg.

Now Wu Qing knows that there has been a big war in the north, and the distance is not too far, so it is completely feasible to send troops to fight.

Keep fighting and make the Zerg base fully operational, this is the way for the Zerg to develop.

Hearing that Wu Qing is willing to send troops to support, Nagalong, a Naga man who is much taller than Wu Qing, was so excited that he couldn't speak.

The area where the Zerg is located is now the forefront of the camp war. All races and territories are facing huge pressure. It is almost impossible to provide military support to other forces!

It is not easy for everyone to persist on the front line.

"Lord! Are you really willing to send troops to support my tribe?!"

Nagalong asked excitedly.

"After two major battles here, a large number of troops from the evil god camp were consumed. The evil god camp should not be able to organize a large-scale attack in a short time!"

"Our defense pressure is very small. A large number of troops have been supported by the tribe. It's better to go to the front line to contribute some strength!"

Wu Qing found a reason to explain.

"As long as the lord sends troops to help, our tribe will definitely compensate the lord!"

Nagalong was very sensible at this time and took the initiative to say that he would give compensation, fearing that Wu Qing would regret it.

"Okay, my territory here has just been established, and even the city has not been built yet, and I just need some things."

"I will make a list of what I need, and then the nobles will look at the performance of the Zerg army and give some compensation appropriately."

Wu Qing took advantage of the situation and agreed to this matter.

The price was also given by the other party. Under this situation, this pricing method may gain more.

Earn one share from fighting and another share from compensation. This deal is very cost-effective!

The Naga tribe only needs to pay some external objects to get the much-needed reinforcements, and it will not lose money!

This is a win-win deal.
